nodes.text: @BruceB010 I'll be hitting 70 this year...NOT looking forward.  Dermatology is the worst.  Every skin thing is "old age".  I had a rash, diagnosed by a hematologist/oncologist friend as human metapneumovirus which I'd never heard of in 40 years as RPH. Dermatologist: "old age"!
